entities.summary: Uganda is a sovereign nation in East Africa, Africa. Its capital is Kampala. Official languages include English, Swahili. Government: Unitary presidential republic (dominant-party). Population: approximately 48.6 million. Area: 241,038 km². Comprehensive index for Uganda covering Bunyoro-Kitara, Buganda Kingdom, Speke/Baker source of the Nile, British protectorate, Obote, Idi Amin, Bush War, Museveni/NRM, LRA/Joseph Kony, and oil discovery.
